title: FuseLIP: Multimodal Embeddings via Early Fusion of Discrete Tokens
abstract: arXiv:2506.03096v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Contrastive language-image pre-training aligns features of text-image pairs in a common latent space via distinct encoders for each modality. While this approach achieves impressive performance in several zero-shot tasks, it cannot natively handle multimodal inputs, i.e., encoding image and text into a single feature vector. As a remedy, it is common practice to use additional modules to merge the features extracted by unimodal encoders. In this work, we present FuseLIP, a new architecture for multimodal embedding. Leveraging recent progress in discrete image tokenizers, we propose to use a single transformer model operating on a unified vocabulary of text and image tokens. This early fusion approach allows the different modalities to interact at each depth of encoding and obtain richer representations compared to common late fusion. We collect new datasets for multimodal pre-training and evaluation, designing challenging tasks

translated_title: FuseLIP：通过离散标记的早期融合实现多模态嵌入
translated_abstract: arXiv:2506.03096v2 公告类型：替换-交叉  摘要：对比语言-图像预训练通过每个模态的独立编码器，在公共潜在空间中对齐文本-图像对的特征。虽然这种方法在多个零样本任务中表现出色，但它无法原生处理多模态输入，即无法将图像和文本编码为单一特征向量。作为一种补救措施，常见做法是使用额外模块来合并由单模态编码器提取的特征。在这项工作中，我们提出了FuseLIP，一种用于多模态嵌入的新架构。利用离散图像标记器的最新进展，我们建议使用一个在文本和图像标记的统一词汇表上操作的单一Transformer模型。这种早期融合方法允许不同模态在编码的每一深度进行交互，与常见的晚期融合相比，获得更丰富的表示。我们收集了新的多模态预训练和评估数据集，并设计了具有挑战性的任务。
tldr: 本文提出FuseLIP架构，通过早期融合离散文本和图像标记的统一词汇表，让单Transformer在编码各深度交互模态，以生成更丰富的多模态嵌入，并配套新数据集和挑战性任务。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes FuseLIP, an architecture that early-fuses discrete text and image tokens into a unified vocabulary, enabling a single transformer to interact across modalities at every encoding depth for richer multimodal embeddings, along with new datasets and challenging tasks.
